results.evidence: The AAJ report confirms the 40 m of 4th-class rock, 100+ m of 50-degree ice and 100+ m of rappelling came while crossing the range to the Sisters Glacier just south of South Twin, not on Little Sister's South Couloir (so pitch_detail, max_angle 50, AI1 and hazards[0] are misattributed). Sources split on the climbing window: one peak guide gives best season July through August with early July good, while other accounts describe June or July as best and early-season ascents from late May are documented (Memorial Day 2023). The row's argument against June rested on the road, which is wrong (see the road finding): the road past the Fryingpan Creek Trailhead opens in May. Would be settled by two sources agreeing on whether June belongs in the window.

results.correct_value: The White River Road past the Fryingpan Creek Trailhead to the White River Campground lot typically opens in mid-to-late May; only the upper road to Sunrise waits until late June-early July.
results.evidence: NPS opening schedules give the White River Road to the campground lot opening May 25 (2012) and May 18 (2018) versus Sunrise Road June 22 / by July 4th weekend. A 2023 party climbed Little Tahoma from Fryingpan Creek over Memorial Day weekend on the partial spring reopening. The Fryingpan Creek bridge sits about 3 mi from the White River entrance, below the campground turnoff.
